description: One urgent exposure for an agent to judge: the inventory, the component, the vulnerability, the occurrence's Subject id (get security.occurrence/<occurrence>) and why it is here: unjudged, or contested (a judgment is on the pair but none counts). Stable identity only, so the same pair in the same state is the same item.

cve_id.description: The vulnerability's key: its CVE id.

inventory.description: The inventory's key: its SBOM's root purl, or the SBOM's workspace path when the SBOM names none.

occurrence.description: The occurrence's Subject id (the pair of this inventory and component): get security.occurrence/<occurrence>.

state.description: Why the pair is here: unjudged (nobody has judged it), or contested (a judgment is on it but none counts).

name: security.exposure-attention
